name: Профиль, настройки и безопасность

changes.PROFILE-01: Deletion completion and errors are fenced by account generation. Post-deletion sign-out accepts the expected UID, checks it again after waiting for backend serialization, and preserves an unrelated active account. Stale deletion leaves its original journal available for later reconciliation.
changes.PROFILE-02: All profile inputs/photo controls freeze while saving or awaiting readback. A server-acknowledged write with failed readback has a separate retry-only-read state; original draft survives closing/reopening the editor. Readback uses an explicit authoritative server read with deadline. Uploaded avatar data/URL are reused on retry. Revision-checked public projection repair runs outside the save critical path.
changes.PROFILE-03: Shared security-operation lease across provider linking, passkey changes, password email and MFA mutations. Pure security reads have bounded waits; token claims use one coalesced snapshot and initial factors/session checks run in parallel. Writes remain serialized until their real completion. Security retry and operation progress are explicit. Token-status read errors have a separate message and retry path, including the privileged startup gate, rather than being treated as proof of an unprotected session.
changes.PROFILE-04: Exact server aggregation of unreadForOwner replaces newest-100 filtering and the duplicate inbox fetch/listener. Both profile counters load concurrently and coalesce inflight refreshes. Updates occur on notification snapshots, return/foreground and a 60-second interval only while Profile is visible/active. Failed refresh retains known count with explicit failed status.
changes.PROFILE-05: Fixed branded toggle fills, adaptive avatar/region/hidden-organization rows at accessibility sizes, hidden-organization search and confirmation, concise list intro, app-language Apple deletion button with approved unmodified artwork and original revoke/reauth flow. Account-security tab visibility is applied at Profile NavigationStack too. Final visual follow-ups give the region field full width, increase biography height at large text, remove duplicate enrollment heading, and use organization-specific confirmation text.
changes.PROFILE-06: Settings entries no longer label bundled legal version constants as current; authoritative version detail remains in the document reader.

initialRuntime.scope: SDK exact count 137->136 and member denial, save locking/readback recovery, German large editor and owner nested routes passed. Hidden-organization UI test failed reaching a keyboard-covered button; intro shortened and search submission added before confirmation in the follow-up.

completion.scope: Acknowledged save readback, retained draft on sheet reopen, image retry reuse, security coordination/deadlines, exact SDK count and authorization, hidden-organization search/confirmation.

rolesAndPreferences.scope: Role matrix and revocation; admin and ordinary-account UI; device lock, consent/notification reliability, device-language/theme persistence, German dark accessibility editor.

verification.localEmulators: Auth/Firestore demo emulator session stopped after successful SDK verification; no production fixture writes.

finalVisual.scope: Full-width accessibility region picker, taller biography, ordinary-account deletion confirmation opened read-only and blocked without keyword; profile save regressions.

finalSecurityState.scope: Unknown session-claim status is visible/retryable and cannot masquerade as an unauthenticated second factor; owner/admin security-before-legal gate; profile completion regressions.

verification.testCountNote: Reported run counts overlap; they are not summed as unique tests.

boundaries: Simulator fixtures and local demo Firebase Auth/Firestore SDK tests are not physical iPhone production-account end-to-end checks.
No real Apple/Google linking, iCloud passkey, Face ID, APNs receipt, password email or destructive production deletion was performed.
No production data, server functions, rules, legal documents or consent defaults changed.
No TestFlight upload or App Store release; distributed build 116 does not include these source changes.
Two pre-existing dirty project/catalog files are preserved outside this change.
historicalVerificationNotes: Initial compilation found an actor-isolated default argument and misplaced helper; fixed before tests.

First core test process crashed when the new avatar retry test reached an unconfigured Firebase Auth getter. Replaced direct getter with the validated application session identity; CoreVerified then passed all 90 tests.
MCP UIAndSDK call timed out at 300s including preparation; its completed xcresult was read directly. The single UI failure is tracked above rather than hidden.

concurrentWorkPreserved.scope: Unrelated committed news-wave audit scripts; no overlap with this change.
